mapper.sql: id, evidence_uid, candidate_uid, user_id, evidence_type, text, score, signals_json, model_judgement_json, extractor_sources_json, comparison_status, source_message_ids_json, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_evidence ( evidence_uid, candidate_uid, user_id, evidence_type, text, score, signals_json, model_judgement_json, extractor_sources_json, comparison_status, source_message_ids_json, status ) VALUES ( #{evidenceUid}, #{candidateUid}, #{userId}, #{evidenceType}, #{text}, COALESCE(#{score}, 0), #{signalsJson}, #{modelJudgementJson}, #{extractorSourcesJson}, #{comparisonStatus}, #{sourceMessageIdsJson}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending') )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learning_evidence WHERE evidence_uid = #{evidenceUid} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM learning_evidence WHERE candidate_uid = #{candidateUid} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_evidence SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE evidence_uid = #{evidenceUid}
